email.body:
When product banners or social posts share a design, build one branded template and feed it changing campaign data. Bannerbear renders the resulting versions automatically instead of making every variation a separate layout task.

Bannerbear is an image generation API and template tool for marketing automation. Connect a supported data source through a native integration, route it through Zapier, or use the REST API.

For API-led volume, the Image API can batch up to 100 renders in one call. Start smaller: the free trial includes **30 API credits** and requires no credit card.

Use the trial to create an image template and generate real output. You can then judge the workflow with a first set of product banners or social images.
